reviewContext.userProblem: The committed text-layout lint (45cc69f) only checks architecture pages and measures every grapheme at the export estimate of 0.55 em, so CJK, kana, hangul and fullwidth labels that real fonts clip in PNG output are not reported, and freeform/flowchart pages with the same element types get no lint or export warnings.
requiredOutcomes: Q2: label-overflow measures each export-rendered label line with a lint-only wide-aware width (East Asian W/F graphemes at 1.0 em, others at 0.55 em); a CJK label that export draws on one line but is 195 wide in a 120 text area is reported with measured vs available widths; the same-length ASCII label is not (tll-07, tll-09).
Q2: note-overflow adds a wide-line finding and a wide wrapped-height finding for text.note (tll-09).

Q1: TEXT_LAYOUT_LINT_PAGE_KINDS becomes ['architecture', 'freeform', 'flowchart']; lint without --page includes them, lint --page accepts them, whole-page SVG/PNG/PDF exports of those kinds print warnings; other kinds unaffected (tll-09, tll-10).
LINT_NO_PAGES becomes 'The document contains no BPMN, breadboard, architecture, freeform or flowchart pages.' (tll-10).
Help text and docs/cli.md describe the five lintable kinds and the 1 em wide-character measurement (tll-08).
Native parity covers a wide-character label document and freeform and flowchart problem pages; mise run test-cli passes with the release binary and the new block runs (1 pass, 0 skip) (tll-11).
All existing export golden/snapshot tests pass unchanged; lint-ts and typecheck pass; tll-00..11 archived during serial finalization.
nonGoals: Changing export wrapping or geometry: wrapTextLines, glyphAdvance, estimatedTextWidth, measureTextNote, label-layout.ts, node-label.ts, svg-export/** stay byte-identical.
Wide-aware label-collision, note proximity or label height; new JSON fields; lint configuration; export --strict (Q4 default); --element warnings (Q3 default); page kinds other than the three.
Any change to packages/io/src/bpmn, apps/cli/native/**, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, packages/io/src/__fixtures__ goldens or examples/**.
Version bumps, releases, pushes; server, auth or deployment code.
constraints: Export output must not change for any document; prove it with the existing export/golden tests and an empty git diff --stat 45cc69f on renderer, io, native and Cargo paths.

Width classification is deterministic and table-driven (Unicode 16.0.0 EastAsianWidth.txt W and F ranges, binary search), cheap in Boa: no per-character regex, no \p{} escapes, no Intl calls, no quadratic work.
The helper packages/core/src/wide-text-width.ts is not exported from the core index and is imported only by text-layout-lint/rules.ts; text-layout.ts changes only by the export keyword on graphemes.
BPMN/breadboard lint output and order unchanged; rule ids label-overflow, label-collision, note-overflow stable; lint exit codes unchanged.
Fixtures are self-authored generic examples (Payment gateway, a Japanese label in a narrow box); no external issue, customer, organisation, person, product or file names.

Workers follow impl-plans/active/tll-06-overview.md 'Per-worker protocol' items 1-9; bun tests with BUN_OPTIONS=--jsx-runtime=classic; cargo with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true; no emojis; no tool attribution in commits.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Wide-aware measurement is lint-side only, in a separate helper the export never imports, because changing wrapTextLines would change export wrapping and golden output (user-qa Q2 rejected alternative).

Narrow advance copies the private glyphAdvance formula and wideAwareTextWidth multiplies counts, so ASCII text gives a bit-identical width to estimatedTextWidth and existing findings do not move (design 'Wide-aware width helper').
The wide wrapped-height check runs only when all export lines are drawn and uses its own wideFree/wideOffset, so text without wide graphemes never gets the new finding (design 'Rule note-overflow').
Widening page kinds is a constant change because the CLI lint filter and export gate already read TEXT_LAYOUT_LINT_PAGE_KINDS (design 'CLI: nodetto-cli lint', 'CLI: nodetto-cli export').
Tests that used freeform as the not-lintable control switch to uml pages; page kind does not affect rendering, so byte-equality references still hold.
The native CLI runs the same TS bundle in Boa with an Intl.Segmenter shim, so no Rust change; parity is proven by an appended native-parity block (design 'Native CLI').
intentionalTradeoffs: Ambiguous (A) width graphemes are treated as narrow; no font metrics or locale switches.
The W/F table may be transcribed from knowledge of Unicode 16.0.0; tests pin representative code points and table well-formedness but cannot prove completeness.
Existing freeform/flowchart/architecture documents with emoji-presentation or CJK text may get new warning-only findings; export bytes and exit codes are unchanged.
Lint findings no longer strictly match export geometry for wide characters; help text says so.
supportedEdgeCases: node.generic 140x60 with the CJK label -> 'Label line 1 of 1 is 195 wide but the text area is 120 wide at 13px; export clips it.'; same box with 'Payment gateway' -> no finding.
shape.geo 140x60 with the CJK label -> one label-overflow with 'is 195 wide but the text area is 124 wide' ending 'export draws it past the label padding.'.

Fixed text.note 120x44 with a 16-grapheme CJK text -> wide-line finding (182 vs 104) and wide-height finding (3 lines, 58.8 vs 44); 120x80 -> only the wide-line finding; verticalAlign top/middle/bottom does not change results.
ASCII note 200x21.6 'Retry three times' exactly fitting -> no finding (regression guard).
Surrogate-pair code points (U+1F600, U+20000) classified via codePointAt; halfwidth katakana and U+2026 narrow; a single wide grapheme wider than the line still takes one line.
Empty freeform page via --page is clean (exit 0, empty stdout); uml-only document -> EXIT_ERROR with the new LINT_NO_PAGES.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Real per-font glyph metrics, kerning, combining-mark width and Ambiguous-width locale handling.
Wide-aware label-collision, note proximity and label height.
UML, ERD, sequence, usecase, state and other page kinds; --element and non-svg/png/pdf export warnings (Q3); export --strict (Q4).

acceptanceCriteria: packages/core/src/wide-text-width.ts exports exactly WIDE_GLYPH_WIDTH, EAST_ASIAN_WIDE_RANGES, isWideCodePoint, wideAwareTextWidth and wideAwareLineCount; imports only AVERAGE_GLYPH_WIDTH and graphemes from ./text-layout.ts; not exported from the core index.

EAST_ASIAN_WIDE_RANGES is a flat sorted, merged, non-overlapping list of Unicode 16.0.0 W/F ranges starting at 0x1100; isWideCodePoint returns false below 0x1100 and binary-searches otherwise; no regex, \p{}, Intl or linear scans.

wideAwareTextWidth equals estimatedTextWidth (toBe) for text with no wide graphemes and gives 195 for the 15-grapheme CJK label at 13px; wideAwareLineCount follows the greedy grapheme rule with EPS 0.01 and minimum 1.
